storyCards.headline: I Hear You Knocking: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Dave Edmunds's "I Hear You Knocking" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

I Hear You Knocking was released in 1970.

Chart story — peaked at #4 on the Hot 100.
